title: Furnished private room + your own bathroom!
body:

The room comes with a twin bed with bedding, a nightstand and lamp, a desk and chair by the window, a closet, and a full-length mirror. Additional furnishings are available. The bathroom is yours alone, with a tub/shower, sink, and towels already stocked.

title: Single Bedroom Available in 3B2B Apartment in Temescal Oakland
body:
Hello! There is 1 bedroom currently available in this 3B2B apartment in Temescal Oakland. The price is a steal with its location: 3 mins walk to the nearest 6 stop, 7 mins walk to MacArthur BART station, and a lot of amazing restaurants/bars/coffee shops nearby! Whole Foods, USPS are also within walking distance! 
 
The housemate who lives in this room is moving out on November 1st, so we are looking for someone to move in anytime between November 2nd to 30th. 
 
- This bedroom is spacious and has a huge storage/closet space 
- Can easily fit in a queen bed, desk, and additional furniture 
- Unfurnished and available to move in between November 2nd to 30th 
- Rent is $1,165 + utilities/internet per month 
- This bedroom shares a bathroom with another housemate 
- The apartment has 1 living room/dining room, 1.5 kitchens with 2 refrigerators, 1 in-unit washer/dryer 
- There is a backyard with seating and lighting that we share with upstairs neighbors 
- Rent is month-to month, but looking for someone who would like to stay long-term (12+ months) 
- The landlord has an overnight guest policy limited to 7 days per 2 months, additional fee will be applied if exceeding the limit 
- Must be COVID conscious, lgbtqia+ friendly, overall not problematic 
- No smoking or hard drugs (weed is okay outdoors) 
 
The other two housemates (both She/Her), are working professionals in their late 20s and early 30s. One of them works a hybrid schedule, and the other is mostly onsite. We mostly keep to ourselves but are respectful and polite when crossing paths in the common areas. 
 
We are looking for someone who is respectful, clean, quiet, financially secure, communicative, and mindful of communal spaces. 
 
If interested, for faster reply you can text for more info or leave your number and email or reply to the posting.
